findings.what: SR controller IC (UCC24610) not included - gate drive signals are ports per architecture decision to use discrete controller in separate block
VCC supply for gate drive is power symbol (+12V) not a port - connects by name across design
BSC010N04LS has no pinout check needed - generic MOSFET symbol with drain/gate/source connections verified correct
Both SR MOSFETs have all pins connected: drain (to SEC_A/SEC_B), gate (to SR1_GATE/SR2_GATE ports), source (to sense resistor then GND)
Power symbols GND and +12V used correctly - no supply pins on MOSFETs beyond gate drive
Voltage compatibility verified: SEC_A/SEC_B peak ~18V < 40V MOSFET rating. Gate drive 0-12V compatible with Vgs_th 2-3V and Vgs_max 20V.
Gate pull-down resistors (10k) ensure gates default to off state when SR_GATE signals are floating
Port directions verified: SEC_A, SEC_B, SR1_GATE, SR2_GATE are inputs (from transformer and controller). CT is output (to filter).
CT output driven by center-tap connection point where both SR FET sources combine through sense resistors
Current sense resistors R_SENSE1, R_SENSE2 included for telemetry - marked as optional in rationale, can be DNF
Bootstrap capacitors C_BST1, C_BST2 included but marked DNF - only needed if discrete gate driver uses bootstrap topology
VCC decoupling capacitor C_VCC included for gate drive supply filtering

review_summary.topology: Center-tap synchronous rectifier with two N-channel MOSFETs
review_summary.mosfets_verified: Q_SR1, Q_SR2 connected correctly to SEC_A, SEC_B drains and common source ground
review_summary.gate_drive_interface: SR1_GATE, SR2_GATE ports receive gate signals from external SR controller block
review_summary.optional_components: Current sense resistors and bootstrap caps marked for conditional fitment
review_summary.power_connections: GND and +12V power symbols used correctly, no floating nodes
review_summary.ports_validated: All 5 ports (SEC_A, SEC_B, CT, SR1_GATE, SR2_GATE) have correct direction and connections
review_summary.deviations_justified: SR controller IC omitted per architecture - implemented in separate discrete block

notes_for_simulator: Values are placeholders - simulator should verify R_SENSE dissipation and C_VCC sizing
Gate drive timing (rise/fall times) depends on external SR controller implementation
Body diode conduction interval cannot be simulated without knowing SR gate timing
Thermal analysis should include both MOSFET conduction loss and sense resistor dissipation
